title: BigP3BCI Study H — 9x8 checkerboard with gaze conditions (16 healthy subjects)
description: This dataset comprises EEG recordings from 16 healthy subjects performing a P300-based brain-computer interface task using a 9x8 checkerboard stimulus grid with gaze conditions. The data were collected at 256 Hz sampling rate using 16 EEG channels and represent a subset of the BigP3BCI study, the largest public P300 BCI dataset. This derivative dataset is processed and organized according to BIDS standards for use in BCI benchmarking and P300 detection research.
methods_description: EEG data were acquired using a g.USBamp amplifier (g.tec) with 16 channels arranged in a standard 10-20 montage at a sampling rate of 256 Hz with 60 Hz line frequency filtering. Subjects performed a P300 speller task with a 9x8 checkerboard stimulus grid under gaze conditions. Each session included target and non-target visual stimuli with a trial interval of 0-1.0 seconds. HED 8.4.0 event annotations were applied to classify sensory events as target or non-target visual presentations.
